svg.text: Three cuts of the same robot. A keeps the speech tail, B is the cleanest at 16 px, C turns the head into a bot with ears.

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

svg.text: The bot inside the bubble: white head, cobalt shell, cloud on the chest. Same face geometry as the app icon, so the character and the mark never drift apart.
• Head = the icon bubble, same 232 : 224 ratio
• Eyes are the icon's pill holes, filled navy for warmth
• Antenna tip = sky glow; the only animated accent
• Chest cloud = DEX Cloud, small enough to drop
• Hands are white mittens: reads at 24 px
Open question: keep the tail only in the icon, or on the character too?
Minimum mark size 16 px · clear space = one eye height
